channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nicolas Batum | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nicolas Batum from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tony Parker on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Parker said via Le Progres.

“We spoke on Tuesday, and it felt a bit surreal to see him retire. Nicolas is one of the best players in the history of French basketball, and he deserves to be celebrated in a big way.”

Tony Parker on Nicolas Batum, Sep 24, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Tyronn Lue on Nicolas Batum:

“We didn't practice today. We'll evaluated Nico better tomorrow. Today we just watched film, walked through some sets, we didn't do anything live.”

Tyronn Lue on Nicolas Batum, Apr 15, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rayan Rupert on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Although Rupert has no memory of watching Batum play — he was only 4 when Batum left Le Mans to play for the Blazers — the lore of Batum hung thick around town.

“Everyone knew of Batum. I was a big fan … he was a big model for me,”

Rayan Rupert on Nicolas Batum, Jan 16, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Nicolas Batum, Marcus Morris, Robert Covington
item.description:
L Frank on Morris/Batum/Covington:

“There will be great competition. All three are really good players. All three bring different things.”

Lawrence Frank on Nicolas Batum, Marcus Morris, Robert Covington, Sep 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on Nic Batum's status:

“I don't know... but it was good seeing him back in the building, I can tell you that. It's getting close and we definitely need him.”

Tyronn Lue on Nicolas Batum, Dec 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Reggie Jackson on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Law Murray:Reggie Jackson on Nicolas Batum:

“There's nothing he can't do... he's in rare air, the things he does. He doesn't ask for credit... that guy is special... he's the glue for our team.”

Reggie Jackson on Nicolas Batum, Nov 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Nicolas Batum, Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Law Murray:Ivica Zubac on Reggie Jackson, Nicolas Batum:

“They're great guys, I don't think anyone expected them to do what they did this year.”

Ivica Zubac on Nicolas Batum, Reggie Jackson, Jul 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Clippers:

“Because [Leonard and George are] such great players, there’s some tendency not to talk about other guys on their team— guys like Mann coming in, what Morris did today, Kennard, the defense that Batum played.”

Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann, Jun 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson, Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on former Hornet Nicolas Batum:

“Without Reggie (Jackson) and Nico this year, we could have been in the Play-In game”

Tyronn Lue on Reggie Jackson, Nicolas Batum, May 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: James Borrego on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:James Borrego on former Hornet Nic Batum:

“He was professional the entire time (when he wasn't playing last season) ... he was great with our young guys,he really embraced the role... he handled himself with professionalism and maturity...”

James Borrego on Nicolas Batum, Mar 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Steve Clifford on his former Charlotte forward Nic Batum:

“You can tell he's in a good place... he is a guy that everybody wants to be on the floor with. He plays for his teammates. His decision making, his size, feel for his game. He has his confidence in his 3-point shot back.”

Steve Clifford on Nicolas Batum, Jan 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: James Borrego on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
1st-year Hornets coachJames Borrego on @Nicolas Batum:

“The ball is not in his hands as much as he’s had it in the past. We’re trying to move the ball around a little bit more. I’ve been proud of how he’s handled it, how he’s competed, especially on the defensive end.”

James Borrego on Nicolas Batum, Jan 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Frank Kaminsky on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
“And then there are those, I want to say ‘Not-so-into-it’ fans who think they know everything, who think they are like the (general manager) of the team and they should make all the decisions. They’re the ones who show up to the games and boo, think they have a better idea how things are done. Those people are never good for an organization. “Nicolas Batum said it (well): You’ve just got to tune out the bad, and focus on all the positive fans and all the good things they say about you. All the people who root for you, those are the people you play for.”

Frank Kaminsky on Nicolas Batum, Jan 18, 2018. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: TJ McConnell on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:McConnell on Batum win guarantee:

“I’m not taking shots at anyone by any means, but it’s disrespectful towards our team.”

TJ McConnell on Nicolas Batum, Feb 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Rich Cho on if it sounds like Nicolas Batum wants to be back in Charlotte after his exit interview:

“He definitely wants to be here. I think he likes the city. He’s grown to like the city. As you know, he just had a child and his family like it here. He loves the coaching staff. He loves his teammates and I think he likes his GM.He wants to be here, we want him here and he’s a big priority for us.”

Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum, May 4, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Rich Cho on how big a piece Nicolas Batum is to the team:

“Nic [Batum] is a huge piece. He is our number one offseason priority. He knows that. I told him that in our exit interviews. We love having him here and he did a great job this year. He had a few injuries, but overall he did a great job on both ends of the floor. [He was] also great in the locker room and I think Nic wants to be here as well.”

Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum, May 4, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Rich Cho on if he feels they will be able to re-sign Nicolas Batum:

“Yeah, I hope so. You never know in free agency, buthe is a priority for us and we hope to get something done with him. I hope he is here for many years to come.”

Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum, May 4, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
The Portland Trail Blazers have acquired forward Noah Vonleh and guard Gerald Henderson from the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for forward Nicolas Batum, it was announced today by President of Basketball Operations Neil Olshey.

“Nic Batum was a key contributor to all of our recent success,”

Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum, Jun 24, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Charlotte Hornets General Manager Rich Cho announced today that the team has acquired forward Nicolas Batum from the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for guard Gerald Henderson and forward Noah Vonleh.

“Nicolas Batum is a very talented player whose all-around game will help our team in a variety of ways,”

Rich Cho on Nicolas Batum, Jun 24, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Paul George on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
“I’m not taking nothing away from Batum or other small forwards in this league, but I feel like those guys are my competition and they’re who I’m going for.”

Paul George on Nicolas Batum, Dec 3, 2013. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Nicolas Batum, Gerald Wallace
item.description:
It’s one of the only things he regrets during his time as the Trail Blazers coach.

“Really, I felt like Nicolas was going to be a good player and a talented player. Again, he was drafted with that in mind, with being a part of the future. Probably the one thing when I look back on my time in Portland that I regret was the decision to take Nicolas out of that lineup and starting Gerald Wallace,”

Nate McMillan on Nicolas Batum, Gerald Wallace, Nov 27, 2013. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Popovich, on Batum's perhaps ill-advised buzzer-beater:

“Why would I be mad at that? He's a good kid. I don't care.”

Gregg Popovich on Nicolas Batum, Nov 3, 2013. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
A trio of Blazers executives, led by general manager Neil Olshey, met with Batum and agent Bouna Ndiaye and told the 23-year-old forward that they intend to keep him in a Blazers uniform no matter what other teams offer him or propose to the team in trades.

“We told Nic that it is in his best interests to sign with us,”

Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum, Jul 5, 2012. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum, Bouna Ndiaye
item.description:
“His job is to be an advocate for his client. ButI think Bouna understands that I inherited Nicolas. It's not like negotiations with me broke down months ago. I got here three weeks ago, he knows he's (Batum) a priority. “But I think he (Ndiaye) also needs to understand that we have a free agent strategy that's depended on how we handle things with Nicolas, could impact the balance of the roster. And we got to have the flexibility to handle that.”

Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum, Bouna Ndiaye, Jun 29, 2012. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
However, he's confident that at the end of the day, Batum will be a Trail Blazer and he's not going to allow anyone to deter them from their strategic plan.

“Nicolas is going to be here and we'll get something done, but it's got to be done sequentially to make sure we maximize our flexibility in free agency,”

Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum, Jun 29, 2012. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Now, in an attempt to maintain leverage, Ndiaye has instructed Trail Blazers general manager, Neil Olshey, not to speak with Batum and he hasn't done so since becoming the team's general manager.

“Out of respect for Bouna, I haven't spoken to Nicolas because it's not right,”

Neil Olshey on Nicolas Batum, Jun 29, 2012. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Larry Miller on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Blazers president Larry Miller on Nicolas Batum's contract extension talks:

“[Restricted free agency] will help determine the market value for us. The good thing is that we have the option to match any offer made to Nic. That will kind of help us determine his market value. It's tough. Agents and players have one perspective, teams have another perspective. Generally you can come to a point of agreement and I think we'll be able to do that in this case.”

Larry Miller on Nicolas Batum, May 18, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Wayne Ellington on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Wayne Ellington on why he threw the ball at Nicolas Batum's backside after garbage time basket at the buzzer:

“When you're up like that you're supposed to hold the ball. That's an unwritten rule. I got frustrated with that. He knows. He knows. It's no big deal, though.”

Wayne Ellington on Nicolas Batum, Apr 2, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Bouna Ndiaye on Nicolas Batum
item.description:
Bouna Ndiaye, who represents Batum, told ESPN.com on Sunday that a deal with SLUC Nancy in France's top league will be finalized in the coming week.

“They are playing in the Euroleague and Nicolas, as a young talent, needs to play to get better,”

Bouna Ndiaye on Nicolas Batum, Aug 1, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.
